source.citation: Business property tax: Ernst & Young LLP for the Council On State Taxation, 'Total state and local business taxes: State-by-state estimates for FY23' (December 2024), Table 5, property taxes paid by businesses on real and personal property ($ billions). Private payroll: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, 2023 annual averages, total annual wages, private ownership, statewide. Each ratio is the first over the second; a business pays its state's ratio on its payroll.
source.estimatedFrom: The five territories are not in the EY study: they take the national ratio ($394.3 billion over $9,532.7 billion of private wages).
